description: Counts of the grammar sweep (internal/querycorpus TestGrammarSweep): the queries enumerated from the LogQL grammar, Loki's answers to them, and every class of difference between the proxy and Loki or VictoriaLogs. A class is the kind of difference, the two answers without their numbers and names, and the grammar element all its queries hold. Each class is held open by a registry case (`case`); a class may only shrink, a new class fails the test, and LVP_QUERY_PLAN_UPDATE=1 rewrites this file keeping the cases of the classes that remain.

case_rules.match: ^(proxy accepts, Loki rejects|error text differs).*\| spacing
^(VictoriaLogs|accepted, translation fails).*\| spacing
^VictoriaLogs rejects the translator text \| .*phi arg
^VictoriaLogs rejects the translator text \| .*json a="b\[
^VictoriaLogs rejects the translator text \| .*(log stage|label_format)
^VictoriaLogs rejects the translator text \| .*(binary left \(|vecagg inner \(|label_replace inner \(|vecagg inner label_replace)
^VictoriaLogs rejects the translator text \| .*rangeagg fn rate \(
^VictoriaLogs rejects the translator text \| .*approx_topk
^accepted, translation fails \| .*requires a range metric
^accepted, translation fails \| quantile_over_time requires
^proxy accepts, Loki rejects \| .*rangeagg .*range
^proxy rejects, Loki accepts \| .*rangeagg .*range
^proxy accepts, Loki rejects \| syntax error at unwrap \| log stage:unwrap
^error text differs \| syntax error at unwrap \|\| (syntax error at unwrap|queries require).*log stage
^proxy accepts, Loki rejects \| syntax error at \( \| rangeagg
^proxy accepts, Loki rejects \| parameter required for operation quantile_over_time
^proxy accepts, Loki rejects \| syntax error at  \| label_replace
^proxy accepts, Loki rejects \| sort and sort_desc
^proxy accepts, Loki rejects \| unexpected literal for right leg
^proxy accepts, Loki rejects \| syntax error at (NUMBER|RATE) \| binary modifier  on
^proxy accepts, Loki rejects \| syntax error at drop \| rangeagg
^proxy accepts, Loki rejects \| syntax error at ip \| log stage
^error text differs, rejected at translation \| .*unknown pipeline stage
^proxy rejects, Loki accepts \| syntax error at \+ \| literal number
^proxy rejects, Loki accepts \| syntax error at / \| binary op //
^proxy rejects, Loki accepts \| stage .* line_format
^tree fact differs: .* \| vecagg agg approx_topk
^tree fact differs: binary operation
^error text differs \| grouping not allowed for approx_topk
^error text differs \| syntax error at  \|\| syntax error at  \| label_replace inner
^error text differs
